name: Musetec Audio
_terms_not_concluded: No terms page found on mu-sound.com, so no prohibition could be checked - NOT the same as finding none. Measured 2026-11-25: the whole navigation was checked and terms.html, legal.html, copyright.html, terms-of-use.html, privacy.html, tos.html and disclaimer.html all 404. robots.txt returns 404, so no Content-Signal and no Claude group exist because the file does not. Footer: « Copyright (c) 2023   MUSETEC Audio   All rights reserved ». Plain HTTP; HTTPS is not served.
_the_maker_changed_its_NAME_and_a_lookal: From its own About page: « Initially used to be called L.K.S Audio, with MH-DA002/DA003/DA004/DA005 and a series of widely acclaimed audio DACs. Since 2019, the new brand MUSETEC has been launched. » So the MH-DA004's specification table reads « L.K.S Audio MH-DA004 » and its copyright page « (c)L.K.SDigitalAudio2017 », while the company is Musetec, and all records sit here. And lksaudio.com is NOT this maker: it is « LAIKESI », a factory for mixers, professional amplifiers, microphones and speakers. It was not used - and its robots.txt carries an explicit group naming ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User and anthropic-ai ending « Allow: / », a permission belonging to the wrong company. Second lookalike domain today, after MUSICIAN's parked musicianaudio.com whose llms.txt said « Disallow-Training: / » on behalf of a registrar.
_the_SPDIF_family_is_always_ONE_combined: Every Musetec table gives one row for the whole S/PDIF family - « COAX 1 / COAX2 / AE S / OPT » on the DA006 generation, « COAX / BNC / AES / OPT » on the DA004 and DA005 - so coaxial, AES/EBU and optical are rated JOINTLY. Each key in `inputs` carries the same figure, which is the maker's grouping and not an inference. Contrast Soncoz, harvested the same day, the only maker in this base that numbers those three sockets separately.
_no_NOS_no_native_and_what_bypass_means_: The string NOS appears nowhere in Musetec's pages or manuals, and no model states an oversampling bypass or filter-OFF position - the six named filter modes are a choice among filters. The only « bypass » wording on this site is « power supply bypass filters », capacitors, and the volume « BYP » key on two remotes. `correctable` is written on no Musetec record. « Native DSD » is never stated in words for any model; DoP is, as « DOP 64x » and « DOP 64~256 ».
_two_models_survive_only_as_a_manual_and: The MH-DA005 and MH-DA004 are off products.html and their detail pages 404, so their manuals are the only maker-published specification left. The MH-DA006Lite is the opposite: its manual has NO text layer - pdftotext returns twelve form-feeds, pdffonts lists no font - so that record comes from the maker's HTML feature list instead. Between them the two cases make the method: read the page AND the manual, because either can be the only one that speaks.
_figures_published_twice_with_different_: Recorded in no field, since this catalogue holds no distortion figure, but worth knowing as a measure of how closely this maker's channels agree. The MH-DA006's THD+N is « > 120dB (A-weighted) » in its manual, « 129dB » in feature 19 of its detail page and « 130dB » on products.html - three values. The MH-DA006MINI's is « > 117dB (A-weighting) » against « 127dB » on two web pages - ten decibels. Also: products.html credits the DA006Lite with « 4. Bluetooth audio connection » while that model's own 20-item list never mentions Bluetooth, and the DA006MINI's detail page opens « The main features of SA001 are as follows », SA001 being the maker's pre-amplifier.
_the_lot_first_cited_a_brand_id_that_DOE: The records were first written citing the short brand id « musetec » while this file's id is the long form. ecrire_lot.fiche_marque() REFUSED to create a second brand file and named this one - the third time that helper has prevented a duplicate on 2026-11-25, after « aune » and « yulong » the same hour. It was written because three duplicates HAD been created earlier the same day, by scripts that fell back to inventing a brand file when they could not find one at the name they guessed.
